comments.body:
Source review found that host guard values (swap, AC, disk and system memory) refresh every five seconds while the declared protocol specifies 200 ms. No guard breach or invalid play has been observed; final play has not started.

SOMA: sample every guard at the declared cadence, add a deterministic guard regression, and retime the corrected source on a fresh pilot root while retaining the first pilot.

CI cannot collect the campaign tests because `psutil` is installed in the M4 research environment but absent from the declared development dependencies. This is a dependency declaration failure; no final-hand or guard failure has occurred. Final science remains pinned to the reviewed clean source.

SOMA: declare the exact monitoring dependency in requirements-monitoring.txt in a separate M4 integration checkout, then require fresh green CI before merging.

Store the native training table compactly

comments.body:
Archive guard breach; campaign stopped at closeout. All fresh 1B training, save exports/full audits and declared final play/replay/reproduction/strict reporting completed successfully before this breach. At **21:47:00 UTC**, the archive guard recorded **869,667,962.88 bytes /829.38 MiB** swap growth from the original 563.56 MiB baseline, over the fixed **512 MiB** limit. Pressure was normal, AC connected, and 45.42 GiB free; these do not waive the swap guard. `campaign-failure.json` latched the failure and the packer stopped. Its later SIGKILL cleanup raised `PermissionError`, so the normal archive operation receipt was not finalized; the exception, admission and raw samples remain. Readback finds no active campaign/packer process. The partial synced ZIP and every research original remain untouched. No accepted archive, end evidence review or merge is claimed.

Verified scientific results remain: loose terminal−parent +214.39 [122.28, 306.51] BB/100 improves; tight +37.05 [-15.00, 89.10] inconclusive (97.5% primaries); separate pot-pressure translation +62.45 [17.15, 107.76] (95%). 143,360 distinct final hands fully replayed/reproduced. Scientific-phase guards passed; this is a later archive-only guard breach, with cause not assigned.

**SOMA:** prepare a separately reviewed archive-only readmission from the retained failure evidence, preserving the original guard/baseline, stopped partial ZIP and unchanged scientific outputs; do not retry this failed admission or merge.
